sd50fbwy.variantName: Walplus 150 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree Quick Setup - Green - 150 cm
sd50fbwy.sourceDescription: This decorative LED string light is designed to elevate your home environment with a touch of modern elegance. Emitting a warm, soft glow, it’s an aesthetically pleasing addition to any setting, whether used to adorn your living room, garden, or terrace. The cone-shaped design, paired with its vibrant green hue, ensures that the string light both complements and enhances the festive ambiance during special occasions like Christmas. Materials: Constructed from PVC, this string light blends durability with flexibility, making it suitable for both indoor and outdoor settings. The steel components enhance its robustness, ensuring it withstands seasonal use while maintaining its structural integrity. The materials chosen guarantee a long-lasting decorative appeal without compromising on the modern aesthetic. Included Components: The set features LED decorative string lights that bring a warm white illumination to any space. The lights are USB-powered, which adds convenience, allowing for easy connectivity and versatility in positioning. This feature ensures users enjoy a seamless and energy-efficient lighting experience for any occasion. Features /Function /Design: Notable for its decorative design, the string light flaunts a modern aesthetic with clean, minimalistic lines. The USB functionality broadens its adaptability, making it easy to integrate into existing decor or for seasonal embellishments. This thoughtful design enhances the user experience with practicality and style. Recommended Uses: The lights are ideal for use in living rooms, gardens, and terraces, where they add warmth and festivity. Whether used for family gatherings or quiet evenings, the lights create a soothing ambiance tailored for enjoyment and relaxation. Care &Maintenance: To ensure longevity, follow the assembly instructions carefully. The USB connection should be handled with care, and lights should be stored in a dry place when not in use to maintain their quality. kt2hrksv.sourceDescription: Tired of sparse, artificial-looking holiday trees that wobble and drop messy needles? The HOMCOM 5ft artificial Christmas tree transforms your seasonal setup into a luxurious experience. Featuring 513 main branch tips, its realistic PE foliage offers a soft, authentic touch and lush fullness without the clean-up. Anchored by a fir wood base for balance and rustic style, this flame-retardant tree automatically opens via hinges—giving active homes a safe and timeless festive centerpiece. • The Xmas tree features a 5ft full-bodied holiday profile, creating an impressive centerpiece for living rooms, offices and foyers • Engineered with 513 main branch tips and each with 13-tip clusters for extreme density • The PE foliage provides a real-touch softness and authentic forest realism • Hinged tips drop automatically, making shaping quicker than normal trees • Sectional trunks make storage compact once festivities end • Flame-retardant PE and PVC foliage slow fire spread for family-first holiday safety • A robust fir wood base (Φ50 x 22H cm) delivers stability and a unique, elevated wood aesthetic • Colour: Green • Material: PE, PVC, Steel, Fir Wood • Overall Dimensions: Φ96 x 150H cm • Base Dimensions: Φ50 x 22H cm • Branch Tip Count: 513 • Item Label: 83C-297V00GN • Shaping Note: Approx. 30-50 minutes of manual branch tips shaping recommended to achieve maximum natural fullness Warning: for decoration only. Keep away from open flames, heaters and other heat sources. Ensure the product is stable before use. Keep small parts and packaging away from children. Stop using if damaged. 1 Northampton Cross Logistics Park Northampton Cross Road Northampton NN4 9FH

qezzm36z.variantName: Christmas Tree World 60cm Green Metallic Inflatable Mirror Ball - Pack of 1
qezzm36z.sourceDescription: Introducing the 60cm Inflatable Mirror Display Ball in Green, a striking and versatile decorative solution designed to create instant impact in retail environments, commercial venues, events, exhibitions, and the home. Featuring a sleek mirror finish, this inflatable display ball reflects light and surroundings beautifully, making it ideal for eye-catching shop windows, visual merchandising, brand activations, and large-scale installations. A key advantage for commercial users is ease of storage. Once deflated or with the air removed using a compatible electric pump the display ball folds down to a fraction of its inflated size, making off-season storage simple and space-efficient. Manufactured from fire-retardant materials, the Inflatable Mirror Display Ball is suitable for use in commercial and public spaces. It is inflated once, sealed securely, and displayed without the need for a continuous power supply. Product Features • Size: 60cm (other sizes available) • Colour: Green (other colours available) • Finish: High-gloss mirror effect • Material: Durable inflatable construction • Fire-resistant: Fire retardant material • Indoor & outdoor use • Installation options: Floor-standing, ceiling-hung, wall-mounted or secured to ground • Inflation: Inflated once and sealed no continuous air supply required • Storage: Fully deflates to take up minimal storage space • Pump: Electric air pump not included • Oversized gold bauble caps not included • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester WN5 8DB

t6b1an9b.sourceDescription: This Christmas decoration storage bag is designed to accommodate wreaths, garlands and pop-up Christmas trees. It provides storage space for wreaths up to 75cm in diameter and garlands of various lengths. The bag is also compatible with Ultra Pop-Up Christmas trees, offering a dedicated storage solution when decorations are not in use. Standard artificial Christmas trees require a differently shaped storage bag, and the accessories shown in product images are not included. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester WN5 8DB
